title: Slovakian Beef Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with beef dumplings, perfect for a cold winter evening. This recipe is also gluten-free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, caraway seeds, onion, eggs, and gluten-free flour. Mix well until everything is fully incorporated.
Gradually add the sour cream and water, mixing until the dough comes together. If the dough is too dry, add a little more water.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces, about the size of a golf ball.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with a little water and sprinkle with some caraway seeds.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for about 20-25 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with some chopped fresh herbs if desired.
